messages:
Anjali (Support): FYI customer (tenant: t-92b7) reports a bunch of 403s that look like invalid API key in our SDKs. They hit it while trying to run batch embeddings. Error they paste: `{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"Invalid key"}`. They insist their key works for other routes. Can eng take a look?

Kevin (Eng): Can you paste a repro curl and the exact response headers? Might be a scope/plan entitlment check returning a generic auth error.

Anjali (Support): Repro included below. This is from their app on us-west-2, timestamp ~2026-11-12 14:02 UTC.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":["a","b"]}'
```
Response: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`
Body: `{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"Invalid key"}`
Headers: `x-tenant-id: t-92b7`, `x-region: us-west-2`, `x-request-id: r-0a1b2c`

Marta (Billing): I looked up tenant t-92b7 — they're on Starter plan and their embeddings quota is 0/10k for the month? Wait actually they were migrated last week from trial and we toggled an entitlement flag to block embeddings until they upgrade. They should get a plan-gate error, not invalid key.

Kevin (Eng): That matches my suspicion — entitlement middleware is currently returning the same 403 payload we use for auth failures. We surfaced generic `invalid_api_key` because the early auth/entitlement handler maps all 403s to the same error code. Not great.

Ben (SRE): Do we have logs showing which code path returned the 403? I can pull request logs for r-0a1b2c.

Ben (SRE): Log excerpt: `WARN entitlement: tenant=t-92b7 check=embeddings allowed=false rule=plan_feature_flag code=ENTITLEMENT_BLOCKED`. Upstream handler then did `return 403` and the error formatter used `invalid_api_key` template.

Kevin (Eng): Ok actionable: 1) Change entitlement failure to return structured error with code `entitlement_required` and message indicating feature and plan. 2) Update SDK mapping so support displays clear UI messaging. 3) Add telemetry tag so we can route these in support UX.

Anjali (Support): Customer-facing workaround while we fix? They need an immediate unblock.

Marta (Billing): We can toggle the per-tenant feature flag to re-enable embeddings for them for 48h while they sort their billing upgrade. I can do a temporary lift if support confirms.

Anjali (Support): Please do that — please document the change in the ticket. I'll tell the customer.

Kevin (Eng): I'll prepare the code change and a short canary. Plan: patch entitlement handler to add error payload like `{"error":"entitlement_required","feature":"embeddings","required_plan":"Pro","message":"Upgrade required to use embeddings"}`. Then update the formatter used for both auth and entitlement to avoid leaking `invalid_api_key`.

Kevin (Eng): Does anyone object to the error code choice? We want a distinct code so client apps can programmatically handle it.

Marta (Billing): `entitlement_required` is fine. We also need to ensure the admin console surfaces the exact missing entitlement for admins.

Ben (SRE): Quick note: watch latency — the entitlement check does a remote plan lookup for older tenants which adds ~30ms p95. If we change formatting logic, make sure we don't add extra RTTs to the auth path.

Kevin (Eng): Good point. I'll implement the change in the in-process middleware: return structured error from the local check if available; fall back to remote lookup only when necessary. No external calls on the fast path.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-2026-11-12-17:10 -> services/auth-middleware (rev: entitle-clarify-42) :rocket:

Anjali (Support): Marta — flag lifted for t-92b7 for 48h, customer confirmed they can proceed. I'm logging the workaround in the ticket and telling them we'll make the error clearer in the SDK/console. :white_check_mark:

Marta (Billing): Noted. We should also run a quick query to find other tenants who were migrated last week — to proactively check for similar confusion. I'll run the query and post results.

Kevin (Eng): Canary looks good in the first 5m. Response payload now returns: `{"error":"entitlement_required","feature":"embeddings","required_plan":"Pro","message":"Upgrade required to use embeddings"}` for blocked calls.

Ben (SRE): No errors in canary logs, p50/p95 unchanged. Rolling canary to 10% now.

Anjali (Support): I'll update our support KB to include the new error string and instructions: if `entitlement_required`, check tenant plan and billing migration, do temporary lift if needed.

Kevin (Eng): Followup items: (1) SDKs: map `entitlement_required` to a clear exception with guidance link. (2) Console: surface the missing entitlement on API key detail page. (3) Telemetry: add `error_type:entitlement` tag for analytics. I'll open PRs for all three.

Marta (Billing): I'll also propose a small email to migrated tenants warning them of gated features after migration — to reduce surprise.

Anjali (Support): Great work team. Closing loop with customer now. :pray:
